title: Warmth Latency Calculation
description: Given an array of daily temperatures, determine for each day the number of days you must wait until a warmer temperature occurs. If no warmer temperature is expected in the future, the waiting period for that day is 0.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the number of days.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing daily temperatures.
output_format: Print n space-separated integers representing the number of days to wait for a warmer temperature.
